paite: Ephraim tanggam Ramathaim-zophim ah mi khat a-om a, amin Elkanah ahi a, amah Jeroham tapa, Elihu tapa, Tohu tapa, Ephraim mi Zuph tapa ahi.
heading: Elkanah Leh A-inkuan Shiloh Ah

paite: Ama'n zi nih anei a, akhat min Hannah ahi, akhat min Peninnah ahi. Peninnah in tate anei a, Hannah in bel tate anei kei hi.
Huai mi akhua ua kipan Shiloh ah Sepaihte' TOUPA houpih ding leh kithoih ding in kum teng in ahohtou hi. Huai ah Eli tapate nih, Hophni leh Phinehas, TOUPA siampute a-om uhi.
Elkanah kithoih ni ahong tun in, azi Peninnah leh atapate leh atanute tengteng tantuan abawlsak hi.
Hannah tan nih abawlsak a, Hannah lah a-it mahmah ngal a. Himahleh TOUPA'N asul akhaksak hi.
TOUPA'N asul akhaksak ziak in alangnu'n alungkhamsak nak hi.
Huchibang a kum teng a ahih ziak in TOUPA inn ahohtouh teng in alungkhamna atokthou nak hi. Huchi in akapkap a, an leng ane kei.
Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hannah, bang achia ahia na kah? Bang achia an ne lou na hia? Bang achia lungkham na hia? Tapa sawm sang in nang a ding in ka hoihzaw kei a hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Shiloh a anek ua adawn khit un Hannah adingh a, siampu Eli TOUPA tempul kong khuambul a atutna ah atu hi,
heading: Hannah Leh Eli

paite: Hannah lungsim haksa mahmah in a-om a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a, khase mahmah in akap hi.

Thu achiam a, "Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, na sikhanu gimna en a, na hon theihgige a, na sikhanu na hon mangngilh louh a, na sikhanu tapa na piakleh adamsung teng TOUPA ka pe dia, alu ah mulmetna zat ahi kei ding,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA ma a athum san lai in Eli in amuk-phun ana chiamteh hi.
Hannah in alungtang in agen a, amuk kia atangsak a, a-aw bel zak ahi kei hi. Huaiziak in Eli in zukham asa hi.
Huchi in Eli in akiang ah, "Bang tan ahia kham a na om nilouh ding? Na uain koihmang in," achi hi.
Hannah in, "Kham kei veng e, ka toupa. Lungsim lungkham mahmah numei ka hi. Uain leng, zu chik leng ka dawn kei, TOUPA ma ah ka lungsim ka suahkhia ahi zaw.
Na sikhanu Belial tanu in hon ngoh het ke'n. Ka lungsim a dimlet lunggimna leh ka lungkhamna genkhia ka hi zaw hi,” chi in adawng hi.
Eli in, "Lungmuangtak in pai in, Israelte' Pathian in na thilnget nang hon pia hen," chi in adawng hi.
Ama'n, "Na sikhanu na mitmuh in deihsakna musak in," achi hi. Huchi in numei apaita a, an ane a, lungkham mel aputa kei hi.
Zingsangpi in athou ua, TOUPA abia ua, apai ua, Ramah a a-inn uh atung nawnta uh. Elkanah in azi Hannah akithuahpih a, TOUPA'N amah atheigige hi.
heading: Samuel Pianna Leh Latna

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hannah in nau apai a, ahun ahong tun in tapa anei hi. "TOUPA ka nget ziak in," chi in amin Samuel asa hi.
Huchi in Elkanah leh a-inkote tengteng TOUPA ma a kum teng a akithoihna uh lan ding leh athuchiam uh tangtun ding in ahong paitou uhi.

Hannah bel ahohtou kei hi. Apasal kiang ah, "Kei zaw naupang in nawinek atawp masiah ka hohtou kei ding. Huai hun chiang in TOUPA ma a akilat theihna ding in ka pi ding. Huai ah a-om nilouhta ding," achi hi.

Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hoih ding na chih bang zel in hih in. Anawinek na tawpsak tan in om in. Himahleh TOUPA'N athu hihkip lel hen," achi hi. Huchi in nawinek atawp masiah huai ah numei a-om a, atapa nawinek atawp masiah nawi anesak hi.
Nawinek atawptak in, tangbuang ephah khat leh uain thawl khat tawi in bawngtal kum thum a upa toh Shiloh a TOUPA inn ah ata naupang chik paipih in, apitou hi.
Bawngtal khat gou in, naupang Eli kiang ah api uhi.
Ama'n, "Toupa, na hin bang in ka gen ahi, kei zaw, aw toupa, hiai lai a na kiang a dingh a TOUPA kiang a thum numei ka hi.
Hiai naupang ngen in ka thum a, TOUPA'N ka nget ahon peta.
Huaiziak in ke'n leng TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Adamsung teng TOUPA a dia lat ahi," achi hi. Huai ah ama'n TOUPA abia hi.
